wiki.title: Jheanelle Wilkins
wiki.extract: Jheanelle K. Wilkins (born May 29, 1988) is an American politician who has represented District 20 in the Maryland House of Delegates since 2017. A member of the Democratic Party, she served as the chair of the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland from 2022 to 2026.
